observations: Photo shows a beige/cream manual sewing machine on a stand with a foot pedal and power cable.
Brand/model text is visible on the front panel: “IDEAL TOPSTAR”.
There is visible dust/age and some wear on the machine body and bed.
The needle area and presser foot are visible, but no close-up of stitching/operation is shown.
A foot pedal is present; no accessories (bobbin case, needles, thread, presser attachments) are shown.

claims.claim: Ideal Topstar manual sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows “IDEAL TOPSTAR” on the machine.
photo 0 shows a foot pedal and machine body, but does not show whether it is fully manual vs electric-assisted; seller text alone can’t confirm.

claims.claim: Works/ideal condition (implied by “available” without defects stated).
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows wear/dust; no test run or stitching sample is shown.

risks.risk: Machine may not sew properly (timing, feed, tension, or motor/drive issues). Photos can’t confirm operation.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of a full test: thread loaded, bobbin inserted, sewing a straight line on fabric, showing feed and even stitches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to work (worst case: needs service/parts).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (bobbin case, bobbins, needles, presser feet, power adapter/cord condition). Photos only show the machine and pedal.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo checklist laid out: bobbin case(s), bobbins, needles, all presser feet/attachments, and confirmation of included power cable/pedal.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst case: buyer may need to buy missing parts).

risks.risk: Pedal/cable may be faulty or unsafe (common with used machines). Photos can’t confirm electrical condition.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing pedal response (speed changes) and a close-up of the cable/pedal for damage; ideally a brief functional demo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as pedal/electrical condition unknown (worst case: may require replacement).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible (rust inside, broken parts, worn gears, bent needle bar).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of: needle bar area, feed dogs, bobbin compartment, and underside/gear area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible internal wear (worst case: service may be needed).

proof_requests: Video test: load thread + bobbin and sew a straight line on fabric (show even stitches).
Photos of bobbin compartment and feed dogs (close-up).
Photos of included accessories: bobbins, bobbin case, needles, presser feet/attachments.
Video showing pedal speed control and that the machine runs smoothly.
response.reason: The brand/model “IDEAL TOPSTAR” is readable from the photo, but there’s no proof of working condition or completeness. For a used sewing machine, operation, tension, and included parts determine the real value, so proof is needed before pricing confidently.
